summary: SeaweedFS is an AWS S3-compatible object store (Go) with a full AWS-IAM-compatible identity subsystem: IAM users and roles, access-key credentials, managed and inline policies, groups, and service accounts, served over an AWS-IAM HTTP API. Buckets and objects are persisted as filer metadata rows (FilerEntry). This env exposes the S3 data plane (bucket and object CRUD plus config writes) and the IAM control plane, all gated by s3:Admin / s3:<action> grants resolved against the signed-in user.
